snippet.title: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4964580/Museologist_Tidy_Up_the_Museum

Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! A single-player simulation. The whole collection has fallen apart. Find where each fragment belongs, piece it back together like a puzzle, and restore 428 objects from 3,105 scattered pieces.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: Tobo Games aka @gamestobo 
📚 Publisher: Tobo Games
📅 Release Date: Sep 25, 2026 
🎯 Genre: Casual, Simulation
